policy_description: Keep BFG COG BOFG_or_LD_gas natural_gas and grid_electricity separate.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus canonical WAG evidence
notes: Do not collapse WAG carriers into a generic WAG balance.

policy_description: COG is generated through an accounting-only coking proxy and not through flexible coking dispatch.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus S2/S3 boundary governance
notes: No coking activity variable coke storage activation or coking flexibility.

policy_description: C0 links WAG to BF BOF and coking proxy. C1 links WAG only to retained BF route and retained BOF coking activity.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze and C1 transition evidence
notes: C1 must not receive the same flat WAG credit as C0.

policy_description: Gross COG is not fully allocatable and mandatory self/process use must remain separate.
notes: Mandatory COG self-use coefficient remains unresolved.

policy_description: Use mandatory process/self-use then steam/boiler then import-offset power interface then flare or spill residual.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus source-evidence structural rows
notes: Shared-stage allocation is proportional to residual eligible carrier energy.

policy_description: No balanced heat-max power-max or alternative allocation-order sensitivity is allowed in S3.0b.
notes: Sensitivity is numerical coefficient sensitivity only.

policy_description: WAG-to-power reduces net site electricity import only and creates no export revenue settlement or Vattenfall dispatch.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus worldsteel and interface evidence
notes: Use potential_import_offset when reviewed capacity is absent.

policy_description: Carry carbon with the WAG flow and count direct CO2 once at combustion flare or explicit transfer.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus MRR FAR IPCC evidence
notes: Do not count emissions at WAG generation.

policy_description: Use separate energy-based CO2 factors for BFG COG and BOFG_or_LD_gas.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus official factor evidence
notes: No aggregate route factor layered over WAG oxidation.

policy_description: Use complete carbon oxidation for CO2 closure in the first development diagnostic.
notes: Methane slip CO slip and non-CO2 flare emissions are deferred.

policy_description: Keep non-WAG residual process emissions WAG oxidation NG combustion other direct emissions and captured CO2 separate.
notes: No complete site-emissions total until residual process factors are available.

policy_description: Compare WAG and natural gas on useful-energy basis rather than raw one-to-one energy.
notes: EU ETS/FAR 0.667 is not a physical conversion coefficient.

policy_description: Captured CO2 remains visible and is not automatically subtracted from emissions.
selection_basis: User-selected freeze plus MRR and MER visibility evidence
notes: Credit requires explicit capture process and eligible sink.

policy_description: S3.0b uses a physical emissions ledger and blocks gross ETS cost while the ledger is incomplete.
notes: Free allocation remains separate and must never be netted silently.
